_comment: TEMPLATE (not a prototype): news headline (RSS + keeper snapshot) -- v2
claim: The BBC News front-page RSS feed lists an item whose title contains the phrase 'interest rates' at a keeper snapshot taken between 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z and 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show a BBC News RSS item whose title contains 'interest rates', captured by a keeper snapshot between 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z and 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z?

custom_definitions: RSS holds only the latest ~30 items, so only keeper snapshots inside the window can prove a headline; a later fetch proves nothing and is never NO.
Headlines are rewritten after publication; the title in a snapshot is what counts and later edits are ignored (FIRST_REPORT_V1).
Only the named outlet counts; aggregator echoes do not.
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.
